CHHATRAPATISHAHU |I MAHARA| UNIVERSITY, KANPUR
Ref: CSJMURECPro-ERG/Ad-02/2026
(Formeriy Known as Kanpur University Kanpur-208024)
Advertisement for Engagement of Project Staff
(Under UP R&D, and CV Raman Research Grant, CSJMUSchemes)
Applications are invited from eligible and interested candidates for engagement as Project
Staff under various research projects sanctioned under the Uttar Pradesh Research &
Development (UPR&D) Scheme and CV Raman Research Grant Scheme at CSJMU,
Kanpur.
Date - 12-05-2026
The engagements are purely temporary and co-terminus with the respective projects.
Details regarding the number of positions, eligibility criteria, emoluments, and schedule
of walk-in interviews are provided in the respective advertisements attached herewith.
Interested candidates are advised to carefully go through the detailed advertisement and
attend the walk-in interview as per the specified date, time, and venue along with all
required documents. Contact can be made to the respective project investigator(s) by the
email for any queries.
No TA/DAshall be admissible for attending the interview.
Dean (Projects)
CSJMU, Kanpur
At+
NAAC
